column3: “Palace” and “officials” specify house and servants; the final singular “he” is pluralized.
“King” and “exiled” identify the dead person and the departing person.
Extortion and oppression are presented in a different order from oppression and violence.
“Drive away” replaces the image of wind shepherding the shepherds.
“You” integrates the initial third-person name into direct address.
Those who seek his life and those he fears are presented in reverse order.
“You” replaces “they”; the lifting of their soul is rendered as longing.
“Or” replaces “and” between sitting on David’s throne and ruling in Judah.
